arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
translation: Allah—there is no god worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth... He is the Most High, the Most Great.
source: Quran 2:255; Hisn al-Muslim, morning and evening remembrance
benefit: Recited in the morning.

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
translation: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there anything comparable to Him.
benefit: Recite the three protective surahs three times in the morning.

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of the night when it grows dark, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when they envy.
benefit: Recite the three protective surahs three times in the morning.

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, the King of humankind, the God of humankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into the hearts of humankind, from among jinn and humankind.
benefit: Recite the three protective surahs three times in the morning.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god worthy of worship except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I uphold Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your favors upon me and my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
benefit: Say with conviction in the morning.

arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
translation: We have entered the morning and all sovereignty belongs to Allah. Praise is for Allah. There is no god worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it, and seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what follows it.
benefit: Morning remembrance.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
benefit: Morning remembrance.

arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
benefit: Say three times in the morning.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
benefit: Say three times in the morning.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family, and my wealth.
source: Sunan Abi Dawud 5074; Sunan Ibn Majah 3871
benefit: Morning and evening supplication.

translation: Allah—there is no god worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth... He is the Most High, the Most Great.

benefit: Recited in the evening.

benefit: Say with conviction in the evening.

To Him belongs sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and what follows it, and seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and what follows it.
benefit: Evening remembrance.

translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.
benefit: Evening remembrance.

source: Sunan Abi Dawud 5074; Sunan Ibn Majah 3871
benefit: Morning and evening supplication.

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness.
benefit: Say three times after completing the prayer.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
benefit: Recited after the prayer's taslim.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
translation: Glory be to Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance after the obligatory prayer.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
translation: All praise belongs to Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance after the obligatory prayer.

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
translation: Allah is the Greatest.
benefit: Part of the remembrance after the obligatory prayer.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
translation: There is no god worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
benefit: Complete the hundred after the three 33-count remembrances.

benefit: Recited after the obligatory prayer.

translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You well.
benefit: The Prophet ﷺ advised Mu'adh to say this after every prayer.

arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
translation: Allah—there is no god worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth... He is the Most High, the Most Great.
benefit: Recite before sleeping.

arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۝ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
translation: The Messenger believes in what has been revealed to him from his Lord, and so do the believers... Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear... Our Lord, do not impose on us what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector.
benefit: Recite the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night.

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
translation: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there anything comparable to Him.
benefit: Recite with Al-Falaq and An-Nas, blow into the hands, and wipe over the body.

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of the night when it grows dark, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when they envy.
benefit: Recite with Al-Ikhlas and An-Nas before sleeping.

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, the King of humankind, the God of humankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into the hearts of humankind, from among jinn and humankind.
benefit: Recite with Al-Ikhlas and Al-Falaq before sleeping.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
translation: Glory be to Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance taught to Fatimah رضي الله عنها before sleep.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
translation: All praise belongs to Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance taught to Fatimah رضي الله عنها before sleep.

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
translation: Allah is the Greatest.
benefit: Part of the remembrance taught to Fatimah رضي الله عنها before sleep.

arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
benefit: Say when going to sleep.

arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You return it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
benefit: Say when lying down to sleep.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ
translation: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, turn my face to You, and rely upon You, in hope and fear of You.
benefit: Part of the supplication before sleep.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَمَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
translation: All praise belongs to Allah, who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
benefit: Say upon waking.

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
translation: Allah is the Greatest.
benefit: Part of the remembrance reported upon waking during the night.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
translation: Glory be to Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance reported upon waking during the night.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
translation: All praise belongs to Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance reported upon waking during the night.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
translation: There is no god worthy of worship except Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance reported upon waking during the night.

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: There is no might nor power except through Allah.
benefit: Part of the remembrance reported upon waking during the night.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
translation: There is no god worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
benefit: Part of the remembrance reported upon waking during the night.

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
translation: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there anything comparable to Him.
benefit: Morning remembrance, suitable after rising.

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of the night when it grows dark, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when they envy.
benefit: Morning remembrance, suitable after rising.

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, the King of humankind, the God of humankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into the hearts of humankind, from among jinn and humankind.
benefit: Morning remembrance, suitable after rising.

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him.
benefit: The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness and repented to Allah frequently.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
benefit: A light remembrance with great virtue in authentic narrations.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
translation: Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent, and praise be to Him.
benefit: A phrase beloved to the Most Merciful.

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: There is no might nor power except through Allah.
benefit: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
translation: There is no god worthy of worship except Allah.
benefit: The best remembrance.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
translation: Glory be to Allah.
benefit: Among the phrases beloved to Allah.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
translation: All praise belongs to Allah.
benefit: Fills the scale.

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
translation: Allah is the Greatest.
benefit: Among the phrases beloved to Allah.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god worthy of worship except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I uphold Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your favors upon me and my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
benefit: The master supplication for forgiveness.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ
translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being.
source: Sunan Abi Dawud 5074; Sunan Ibn Majah 3871
benefit: A supplication asking Allah for pardon and well-being.
